dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: Ah, that's the stuff! That's the flavor!

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: I started learning to cook when I was a teenager. The Smoked Fish Steak my Granny would make... That's what it tasted like.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: Only the older folks still make it in this flavor. Ah, how nostalgic.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: Granny could call out to me, telling me to eat: "Jaakob! Granny's made fish! Eat it while it's fresh!"

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: It's been a long time since I last saw her... Maybe I'll go visit next month while I'm on leave... next month... how long has it been...

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: If you're by the sea, fish is the natural food of choice — and you did a good job with this one.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: Nod-Krai is close to the sea, and smoked fish has been a staple here for ages. All the old folks know how to make it.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: #{M#Lad}{F#Lass}, you're a dab hand in the kitchen, sure, but traditional Nod-Krai smoked fish is not cured in this way.

dialogues.speaker: Food-Obsessed Phantom
dialogues.text: It's not a taste you'd ever forget once you've had it. *sigh* I wish I could've tried it one more time...
